fields.label: API access key
fields.description: Tenable Vulnerability Management API access key, from My Account -> API Keys (cloud.tenable.com). Generated as a pair with the secret key below; each account has only one active pair at a time -- regenerating invalidates the old pair. Sent inline (not encrypted at rest) as part of the X-ApiKeys header value, since Tenable requires both keys in one header and this binding can only encrypt one field per header; the secret key below carries the actual authenticating secret.

fields.label: API secret key
fields.description: Tenable Vulnerability Management API secret key, from the same My Account -> API Keys pair as the access key. Tenable shows this value only once, at generation time.
